wizard.noProps: No configurable properties. Click Connect to proceed.

device.notInProfileImportHint: Not in the active profile. Import it to the inventory, then add it to the profile's equipment tree (Profiles page).

noSite.title: No observation site yet
noSite.body: Add the place you observe from, then assign it to a profile on the Profiles page. Your location is needed to point the mount and to compute what is visible.

addToInventory.title: {{device}} is connected — add it to your inventory?
addToInventory.body: Devices in the inventory can be put in a profile and connected again in one click.
